cleaners.name: Scrub
cleaners.description: Addresses typical text cleaning needs. Combines stripping spaces, forwarding characters, MIME encoded characters, and paragraphs. SCRUB calls the cleaners in a specific order to insure best results.

cleaners.name: MyScrub
cleaners.description: A shortcut to a user selected custom cleaner. Specify in Preferences > General.

cleaners.name: Remove Extra Spaces
cleaners.description: Replaces multiple spaces with a single space. Note: Leading spaces at beginning of a line are also removed.

cleaners.name: Remove Whitespace Before Paragraphs
cleaners.description: Removes whitespace (spaces,tabs) at the beginning of a paragraph (line).

cleaners.name: Remove Forwarding (>) Characters
cleaners.description: Removes leading '>' (forwarding) marks from a line that are used in some emails.

cleaners.name: Convert MIME-encoded Characters
cleaners.description: Converts either %Hex or =Hex characters to their appropriate ASCII character. Example: a %20 or a =20, is converted to a space.

cleaners.name: Make Paragraphs
cleaners.description: Converts multi-line paragraph with hard returns <CR> into a single paragraph. New paragraphs are marked by two successive returns.

cleaners.name: Remove All Tabs
cleaners.description: Delete all tab characters.

cleaners.name: Remove All Spaces
cleaners.description: Delete all space characters.

cleaners.name: Remove All Whitespace
cleaners.description: Delete all whitespace (spaces,tabs) chcaraters.

cleaners.name: Remove Control Characters
cleaners.description: Delete control characters (ASCII value less than 32) with exception of tab or return.

cleaners.name: Remove Extra Returns
cleaners.description: Converts multiple successive returns into a single return. Same as 'Multiple Returns to 2 Returns'

cleaners.name: Uppercase
cleaners.description: Convert text to “UPPERCASE”.

cleaners.name: Lowercase
cleaners.description: Convert text to “lowercase”.

cleaners.name: Capitalize Sentences
cleaners.description: Capitalize first character of each sentence, with changing existing case of text.

cleaners.name: Capitalize Sentences with Lowercasing
cleaners.description: Convert text to lowercase, then capitalize first character of each sentence.

cleaners.name: Capitalize with Title Case
cleaners.description: Capitalize words using basic Title Case rules.

cleaners.name: Capitalize Words
cleaners.description: Capitalize each word.

cleaners.name: Capitalize Common Tech Names
cleaners.description: Capitalize common industry names.

cleaners.name: Capitalize Lines
cleaners.description: Convert text line to lowercase, then capitalize first character of each line.

cleaners.name: Capitalize Lines with Lowercasing
cleaners.description: #CAPITALIZE_LINES_ALT_INFO

cleaners.name: Randomcase
cleaners.description: Randomize text capitalization.

cleaners.name: Fixup macOS Name
cleaners.description: Convert 'Mac OS X', 'OS X', 'MacOS' to 'macOS'.

cleaners.name: Capitalize Apple Names
cleaners.description: Capitalize Apple-related names.

cleaners.name: Reverse All Characters
cleaners.description: Reverse each of the characters.

cleaners.name: Reverse Word Order
cleaners.description: Reverse the word order of the text.

cleaners.name: Reverse Characters in Each Word
cleaners.description: Reverse the characters in each word.

cleaners.name: Strip Diacritic Marks
cleaners.description: Strip diacritic marks.

cleaners.name: Make Unicode Names
cleaners.description: Convert characters to their Unicode Names.

cleaners.name: Convert to ASCII
cleaners.description: Convert Latin characters to ASCII characters.

cleaners.name: Convert Bullets to ASCII
cleaners.description: Convert bullets to standard dashes ASCII.

cleaners.name: Straighten Quotes
cleaners.description: Convert single and double smart (curly) quotes to straight quotes.

cleaners.name: Smarten Quotes
cleaners.description: Convert single and double straight quotes to smart (or curly) quotes.

cleaners.name: Expand Tabs
cleaners.description: Convert tabs (hex 0x09) into four (4) spaces.

cleaners.name: Rewrap Text
cleaners.description: Fix any paragraphs (see Make Paragraphs), then rewrap text at 70 characters per line. (see Wrap At 70).

cleaners.name: Quote Text
cleaners.description: Rewrap text and insert forwarding marks (‘>’) at beginning of each line. Put a hard return at the end of each line to ensure proper wrapping.

cleaners.name: Wrap At 50
cleaners.description: Fix any paragraphs (see Make Paragraphs), then rewrap text at 50 characters per line.

cleaners.name: Wrap At 60
cleaners.description: Fix any paragraphs (see Make Paragraphs), then rewrap text at 60 characters per line.

cleaners.name: Wrap At 70
cleaners.description: Fix any paragraphs (see Make Paragraphs), then rewrap text at 70 characters per line.

cleaners.name: Quote Text L1
cleaners.description: Rewrap text, placing single forward mark at beginning of each line.

cleaners.name: Quote Text L2
cleaners.description: Rewrap text, placing two forward marks at beginning of each line.

cleaners.name: Quote Text L3
cleaners.description: Rewrap text, placing three forward marks at beginning of each line.

cleaners.name: Quote Text L4
cleaners.description: Rewrap text, placing four forward marks at beginning of each line.

cleaners.name: Quote Based on First Line
cleaners.description: Quote text based on first line. If no forward marks found, simply rewrap. If forward marks are found, use them determine quote level.

cleaners.name: Increase Quote Level
cleaners.description: Increase the quote level of a selection by one, adding a forwarding mark (>) to the beginning of each line.
